answer: Give identities surprise, overlapping deadlines. At a random beacon moment, the network dives like a falcon on a sample of accounts and asks each for a fresh answer within 90 seconds. One operator running 500 heads must serve them all at once, so its load hits its zenith right when every head is tested together. Late or near-identical replies mark the cluster, and its stakes land on a sable-flagged slashing list anyone can audit on-chain. Honest agents barely notice; farms pay in peak compute.
